# 2 Baruch Chapter 66 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "The black waters that came after those bright waters and darkened them represent the deeds of those who wickedly carried on the work of Jeroboam — all those who led Judah into sin."

**2** "The evil deeds of Jehoiakim and all those like him who broke the law are part of these waters."

**3** "These are the sixth black waters you saw."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
